title: cypella bonariensis
intro: Cypella bonariensis, commonly known as the Dwarf Cypella, is a species of flowering plant in the family Iridaceae. It is a perennial plant native to South America, valued for its ornamental and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Cypella bonariensis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage.
